name: Compound V2
description: Compound is an algorithmic, autonomous interest rate protocol built for developers, to unlock a universe of open financial applications.

methodology.UserFees: Total borrow interest paid by borrowers.
methodology.Fees: Total borrow interest paid by borrowers.
methodology.Revenue: Share of borrow interest to Compound treasury.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Share of borrow interest to Compound treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Total borrow interest paid to lenders.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: No revenue share for COMP token holders.

Fees.Borrow Interest: Total borrow interest paid by borrowers across all lending markets.

UserFees.Borrow Interest: Total borrow interest paid by borrowers across all lending markets.

Revenue.Borrow Interest: Protocol reserve factor portion of borrow interest retained by Compound treasury.

ProtocolRevenue.Borrow Interest: Protocol reserve factor portion of borrow interest retained by Compound treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Borrow Interest: Lender portion of borrow interest distributed to cToken holders who supply liquidity.
